justification: B shows a clearly organised composition: a fish/marine creature in profile along the top, two large linked spirals dominating the field, a small figure at the right, and a framing border of parallel incised lines; A shows only faint, weathered relief on a boulder with rounded eye-like hollows and vague curvilinear shapes, with no legible framing or figural scene. Beyond the generic fact of shallow carved curvilinear motifs on rock, there is no shared specific motif, relationship or layout, and A's forms are too indistinct to support any claim of a common iconographic scheme.
